title: wholesome japanese farfalle pasta
description: A creamy, savory, and aromatic dish featuring pan-seared farfalle, lardons-render, and fresh scallions. This Japanese-inspired pasta is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy dinner with friends.
instructions: Combine farfalle pasta and a large pot of boiling salted water, cook until al dente.
Meanwhile, melt 2 tbsp of unsalted butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add lardons-render and cook until crispy, about 4 minutes.
Remove lardons-render from skillet and set aside.
Add remaining 2 tbsp of unsalted butter to skillet and sauté the salmon pieces until cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Add scallions and grated daikon (if using) to skillet and cook until softened, about 2 minutes.
Stir in white sesame seeds and cook for an additional minute.
Add cooked farfalle pasta to the skillet, tossing with soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, green chili flakes, and yuzu juice.
Return lardons-render to skillet and toss with pasta to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
